verdict.rationale: Docs confirm that call recordings, transcripts, and logs are captured and retained per-agent (retell-docs-15/27/44), that webhooks deliver call_ended/call_analyzed events for real-time access to call data (retell-docs-52), and that official SDKs provide 'full voice and chat endpoint coverage' with typed access (retell-docs-2/33/46), plus Conductor can inspect transcripts (retell-docs-57). However, no evidence pack item explicitly documents a 'get recording' or 'get transcript' API endpoint, response schema, or bulk-export workflow, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s, so programmatic retrieval for every call is inferred rather than directly documented. Missing for 10: explicit API/endpoint documentation for fetching recordings/transcripts, confirmed audio file format/access mechanism, and independent hands-on confirmation of programmatic retrieval.
